skills.title: Price Surge Screen
skills.description: Screen tokens surging in price over 1m to 30d on Solana, BSC, Base, Ethereum or Robinhood within a market-cap band, filtered by liquidity, volume and holders, and auto-exclude rows with risk signs, with deeper rug and honeypot checks in advanced mode — showing price change, volume, trades, liquidity and the reason for every exclusion.

usage.input: Chain, surge interval and market-cap band. Standard is the default; choose advanced, top and optional security to bound enrichment. Supported chains in this CLI: solana, bsc, base, ethereum, robinhood.
usage.instructions:
Install birdeye-cli and configure the Birdeye API key locally. Preview the user's filters and CU budget, then run the same command with --max-cu. Standard costs 50 CU. Advanced hydrates at most --top survivors; --with-security adds security, while --no-holder-health skips Solana holder cohorts. --no-auto-filter retains every row with its flags. Top-10 and developer caps require security evidence. Unknown KOL tags are not zero buyers. Use --help for the full filter list; read the detailed reference for interpretation and the /price-surge API contract. HTTP automation uses the separate birdeye-api process: send the user's Birdeye key in X-API-KEY for each live request. The wrapper never uses a server key; estimates need no key. Terminal usage needs no background server.

Use cases:
- Catching momentum early without chasing fake pumps; momentum feeds and alert bots.

## Supported chains and limitations

Supported chains in this CLI: `solana`, `bsc`, `base`, `ethereum`, `robinhood`. Broader upstream API support does not enable additional chains for this skill.

- Up to 100 tokens per run
- Security checks are optional, in advanced mode only
- Holder checks run on Solana only

### Execution notes

- Arbitrum is unavailable because Token List V3 does not document it. Other upstream chains are outside this skill's implemented scope.
- Standard requests one page of 1–100 tokens for 50 CU. Advanced hydrates at most min(top, limit) first-pass survivors; exclusions are not backfilled. Unhydrated rows have no advanced risk assessment.
- Holder health is Solana-only in this implementation, even though the provider also documents Robinhood. Non-Solana runs omit holder profiles and Solana-only trader options.
- Security is opt-in in advanced mode. Developer/top-10 caps remain unevaluated without security; unknown authority, lock, tax or KOL evidence stays null, not a passed check.
- Trader metrics cover at most ten sampled wallets; 1m/5m screens use a 30m trader window. Holder-profile volume uses 1h. Profitability is not a market-wide win rate; a KOL holder count is not a KOL buyer count.

Live requests require a Birdeye key with access to every requested endpoint; coverage may be incomplete. Plans fetch bounded pages, not complete populations. CU estimates exclude retries and are not confirmed billing. Skills perform research, not trading, continuous monitoring or copy-trade backtesting.
usage.result: Ranked candidates, every exclusion reason, bounded advanced evidence, raw source data and CU usage. Unknown risk fields stay null.

use_cases: Catching momentum early without chasing fake pumps; momentum feeds and alert bots.
core_capabilities: Find tokens surging over 1m to 30d on Solana, BSC, Base, Ethereum or Robinhood
Filter by market-cap band, liquidity, volume, trade count and holders
Auto-exclude risky tokens (no or thin liquidity, honeypot or wash-trade patterns) with a reason for each
Advanced mode checks traders and holders on the top survivors, with optional token security
just_say_to_your_agent: Find Solana tokens up most in the last hour, market cap $50K–$5M
Screen BSC tokens surging over 24h and tell me why each excluded token was dropped
Run an advanced surge screen on Base with security checks, and estimate the CU first
limitations: Up to 100 tokens per run
Security checks are optional, in advanced mode only
Holder checks run on Solana only

skills.title: Token Launchpad Trending
skills.description: Scan Solana launchpad tokens — Pump.fun, Moonshot, Raydium LaunchLab and Meteora DBC — by launch stage or bonding-curve progress, filtered by liquidity, showing progress, creator, liquidity and trading activity.

usage.input: Choose source, stage, scan-limit and launch-sort; near-graduation requires min-progress. No token address is needed. Supported chains in this CLI: solana.
usage.instructions:
Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu. Use --depth full --limit 3 only when detailed launch metadata is needed. --min-liquidity filters the launch feed. --from/--to select creation or graduation time; newly-listed uses listing time and requires source all. Ranking covers one page, not the whole market.

Use cases:
- Catching early launches, building launch watchlists, launchpad alert bots.

## Supported chains and limitations

Supported chains in this CLI: `solana`. Broader upstream API support does not enable additional chains for this skill.

- Up to 50 tokens per run (20 for newly listed)
- Created, listed and graduated are separate stages
- Launch progress is not a safety signal

### Execution notes

- One launch page, up to 50 rows; newly-listed allows up to 20. Full enriches at most 1–5 tokens. No security score is inferred from launch progress.
- Newly listed, newly created and graduated are different events. Newly-listed keeps provider order; other stages use launch-sort. Source coverage is provider-specific.

Live requests require a Birdeye key with access to every requested endpoint; coverage may be incomplete. Plans fetch bounded pages, not complete populations. CU estimates exclude retries and are not confirmed billing. Skills perform research, not trading, continuous monitoring or copy-trade backtesting.
usage.result: A ranked launchpad page with launch stage, progress, market data and observation sources; full depth adds metadata for a bounded shortlist.

skills.title: Token Security Check
skills.description: Check a Solana token’s contract risks — mint and freeze authority, mutable metadata, transfer fees and creator holding, plus provider-reported honeypot and LP-lock flags — with each check marked observed or unknown.

usage.input: A Solana token address. Supported chains in this CLI: solana.
usage.instructions:
Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu. Runs one security request. Treat reported flags as provider observations. On Solana, explicit null ownerAddress/freezeAuthority means the authority is inactive; missing or malformed authority remains unknown. Other null evidence stays unknown. This does not audit source code, simulate a sale or independently verify LP locks.

Use cases:
- Quick rug check before trading; filtering out unsafe tokens early in a pipeline.

## Supported chains and limitations

Supported chains in this CLI: `solana`. Broader upstream API support does not enable additional chains for this skill.

- Fields the provider doesn't report show as unknown
- Honeypot and LP lock are provider-reported, not verified
- No overall safety score or verdict

### Execution notes

- Security payloads vary by token; absent fields remain unknown. No composite safety score or automatic trading verdict is produced.
- Provider-reported honeypot and LP-lock values are not independent simulation or lock verification. Transfer fees are interpreted only with explicit units.

Live requests require a Birdeye key with access to every requested endpoint; coverage may be incomplete. Plans fetch bounded pages, not complete populations. CU estimates exclude retries and are not confirmed billing. Skills perform research, not trading, continuous monitoring or copy-trade backtesting.
usage.result: Security observations with authority evidence, transfer-fee fields, provider-reported honeypot/LP status where available, and unknown checks.

use_cases: Quick rug check before trading; filtering out unsafe tokens early in a pipeline.

- Current holdings do not prove purchases in the window. Missing PnL/holding fields remain unknown; highest volume does not imply trading skill.
